project: Super Mario Galaxy 2 native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Boots to the title screen and the file select. 59-60 fps on both machines; on the mini PC frame times jitter by a few milliseconds with headroom to spare. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
